info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Evaluation Review Submission API
info.description: The Employee Evaluation Review Submission API allows organizations to submit reviews for employee evaluations in their human resource management processes. This API facilitates the recording of performance assessments and provides a structured approach to evaluate employee contributions. Typical consumers include HR professionals and managers who need to document and track employee performance feedback. By leveraging this API, companies can enhance their evaluation processes and ensure transparent communication regarding employee assessments.

post.summary: Create a review for employee evaluation.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a review for the employee evaluation process of a specific employee identified by EMP-900045. It enables HR managers to assess performance and gather feedback effectively.
